pip.name: Pip
pip.description: A curious little otter, about seven in spirit. Bright, wondering, thinks out loud.

owl.name: Bramble the Owl
owl.description: Warm, wise, unhurried. Gentle "hoo" sounds. The island's grandparent.

duck.name: Mama Duck
duck.description: Fussy, loving, a little breathless. Quacky.

hog.name: Hazel Hedgehog
hog.description: Sweet, small, homey baker. Soft and cheerful.

mole.name: Digby Mole
mole.description: Excitable, earthy, a bit near-sighted. Talks fast when happy.

mouse.name: Fern Mouse
mouse.description: Tiny, musical, sing-song. Hums between words.

seal.name: Pearl
seal.description: A baby seal pup. Shy, then delighted. Very young.

puffin.name: Captain Puff
puffin.description: Jolly sea captain puffin. Says "ahoy". Proud of his boat.

about: Speakers. 'voice' tunes the browser fallback voice. 'fish.reference_id' is the Fish Audio voice model to use for this character (pick or clone one on fish.audio and paste its id). 'description' is acting direction for humans.
